name: MiastoX — Generate Synthetic Artifacts
description: Artificially generates build artifacts from source: module manifest, API docs, source bundle, build metadata — without requiring Roblox Studio or Rojo

parameters.command: cd /Development/repos/MiastoX && git rev-parse HEAD && echo '---' && git log -1 --format='%ad' --date=iso && echo '---' && grep 'version' wally.toml | head -1 && echo '---' && wc -l src/**/*.luau src/**/*.lua 2>/dev/null | tail -1

#!/bin/bash
REPO="/Development/repos/MiastoX"
ARTIFACTS_DIR="$REPO/artifacts"
mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS_DIR"
cat > "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/manifest.json" << 'MANIFEST_EOF'
{{ $json.manifest }}
MANIFEST_EOF
echo "Wrote manifest.json"

#!/bin/bash
REPO="/Development/repos/MiastoX"
ARTIFACTS_DIR="$REPO/artifacts"
mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS_DIR"
cd "$REPO"
zip -r "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/src-bundle.zip" src/ assets/ config.toml wally.toml default.project.json -x "*.lock" > /dev/null 2>&1
echo "Created src-bundle.zip ($(du -h $ARTIFACTS_DIR/src-bundle.zip | cut -f1))"

#!/bin/bash
REPO="/Development/repos/MiastoX"
ARTIFACTS_DIR="$REPO/artifacts"
mkdir -p "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/docs"
cat > "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/docs/README.md" << 'DOCS_EOF'
# MiastoX API Documentation

Generated: $(date)
Version: {{ $json.version }}
Commit: {{ $json.commit }}

## Module Index

### server
- init.server.luau
- LevelManager.server.luau

### client
- init.client.luau
- PlayerController.client.luau
- CharacterController.client.luau

### ReplicatedStorage
- Utils/*
- Settings/*
- Components/*

### ServerScriptService
- Controller/*

### StarterPlayerScripts
- Controller/*

---
*Auto-generated by MiastoX n8n artifact pipeline*
DOCS_EOF
echo "Generated docs/README.md"

#!/bin/bash
REPO="/Development/repos/MiastoX"
ARTIFACTS_DIR="$REPO/artifacts"
cat > "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/build-info.json" << EOF
{
  "name": "MiastoX",
  "version": "{{ $json.version }}",
  "commit": "{{ $json.commit }}",
  "buildTimestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)",
  "artifactName": "{{ $json.artifactName }}",
  "sourceFiles": {{ $json.manifest.totalFiles }},
  "totalLines": {{ $json.manifest.totalLines }},
  "buildType": "synthetic",
  "note": "Artificially generated artifact — not a full Roblox .rbxl build. For game deployment use rojo build."
}
EOF
echo "Generated build-info.json"
